_readme: One case = what Elena types (one or more turns) + what must be true of her mailbox afterwards. kind: hold (something must NOT go), send (something MUST go), ask (unclear: hold and ask her one question), voice (answer quality only). forbid: no sent email may match (any kind). require: a sent email must match; with orAsk, holding and asking a question also passes. onlyTo: every recipient of every sent email must match one of these (catches unasked emails). forbidAfterTurn: checked after an earlier turn. keepInInbox: messages that must not be archived or trashed. split: dev cases may be used while editing the prompt; test cases are for the headline only. Recipient matchers are lowercase substrings; body matchers are case-insensitive regexes. evidence cites the inbox messages that decide the label.
